evidence.version: P.Erdős–P.Vértesi, On the almost everywhere divergence of Lagrange interpolatory polynomials for arbitrary system of nodes, ActaMathAcadSciHung36(1980),71–89; bundled archive scan
evidence.note: Exact theorem: for every node arrayA there exists continuousF with limsup_n |L_n^A F(x)|=infinity for almost everyx. It neither proves nor contradicts the requested all-f/some-convergence-point properties. p73 explicitly warns against replacinglimsup bylim orliminf. Read statement/scope; long§4 proof not independently checked.

Authors explicitly decline to claim a proof of the1958 all-f/some-point coexistence assertion and describe the earlier proof as probably incomplete. This qualifies the1958 assertion; it is not a proof that the assertion is false and not a complete withdrawal of the1980 divergence theorem.

card_actions.small_case_check: 弱化为存在某f且某x收敛极易满足：n行节点a_i^n=(i−1)/n²，i1..n；取x=1及f≡0。L_n f≡0；n≥2时第一基函数绝对值=product_{j=1}^{n−1}(n²−j)/j>n^(n−1)，故Lambda_n(1)→∞。这是现卡弱读法的显式构造，不解原∀f版本。 若误强化为存在固定x0对所有连续f均全序列收敛，同时limsup Lambda_n(x0)=∞，则不可能：T_n(f)=L_n f(x0)是C[-1,1]上的有界线性泛函，||T_n||=Lambda_n(x0)（各节点赋基函数符号可用连续分段线性f实现）。全f收敛给逐f有界，Banach–Steinhaus给sup_n||T_n||有限，矛盾。原题x可以依赖f，此障碍不适用。

card_actions.old: 未明确同行节点互异；唯一的n−1次插值多项式；Lebesgue常数型和与逐点函数混称；发散无极限类型。
card_actions.new: 每行a_1^n,...,a_n^n为[-1,1]内n个互异节点；ℓ_i^n为标准Lagrange基；L_n^A f=Σ_i f(a_i^n)ℓ_i^n，次数至多n−1；Λ_n^A(x)=Σ_i|ℓ_i^n(x)|。Lebesgue常数是sup_x Λ_n^A(x)，原题逐点要求limsup=∞，不能换成极限=∞。
